events.title: Update: New PC Interface and More Realistic Models
events.summary: Hi everyone playing BREACHED: Follow Me! 👋I've rolled out a visual update:🖥️ PC interfaceI redesigned the in-game computer interface. It looks cleaner now, closer to a real PC, and fits the atmosphere better.🧱 Updated modelsI replaced and refined some of the models so the environment looks more realistic and alive.Thank you for the feedback and bug reports, they really help make the game better. Let me know if you notice anything!See you in the game.

events.title: Demo update: message history, mug coaster hint + fixes
events.summary: Hey everyone who's played the demo! 👋Made a small update based on your feedback:📜 Message History All the lines and hints that appeared during the game are now saved in a separate log. If you missed something or want to reread it, you no longer need to replay the level.☕ Mug Placement Hint Added a visual hint on the table to make it clearer where exactly to place your mug. events.title: Demo Update: Bug Fixes + New Ending
events.summary: Hey everyone! Pushed a small patch for the demo: • Fixed several bugs that could break the playthrough • Reworked the demo's ending — felt the previous one wasn't good enough, so I decided to make it better No spoilers, but the finale hits different now. If you've already played it, worth giving it another shot 👀 Thanks for the feedback, it genuinely helps make the game better!

events.title: Demo Update #1
events.summary: Hey everyone,I've been going through all the comments and discussions since the demo launched, and I just wanted to say thanks. A few of the bugs you reported never showed up during my own testing, so your feedback has been incredibly helpful.Here's what's new:You can now start a New Game without having to restart the entire demo.Fixed several reported bugs and polished a few rough spots.If you run into any other issues or have suggestions, feel free to post them in the Bug Reports discussion.
